text: time window read: 2025-05-01 00:00:00 to 2025-06-01 00:00:00 (end excluded) (WINDOW_START / WINDOW_END in .env; empty = all data); flare thresholds, reference period and all limits are computed inside this window only

duplicate tag names (spaces and case ignored) keep the first copy in folder order flare_data > APS_NVPS_LEU > DAK > DIU > ISOM > ISOM_3 > ISOM_4 > LOUP > NSU_NHT_CCR > PDA > PG > SEU1 > SEU2 > SEU3; flare folder first so a flare tag is always marked is_flare
all tags resampled to the most common file sampling interval 0 days 00:01:00 (bin mean), as in pca_pc_t2

single flare node flare_net = (LRflare.pv+LREflare.pv+99fi4601.daca.pv)/1000 + 509fi5201.daca.pv/1000 - (44ft2505.pv*509mw5101.daca.pv/22.414)/1000 (FLARE_*_TAG in .env); where the recovery tag has no value: counted as 0 (no recovery) (FLARE_RECOVERY_MISSING = zero)
flaring = flare_net > median + 3 * MAD (MAD x 1.4826), flags <= 5 samples apart merged into one event (pca_pc_t2 s0_audit rule)
reference = rows before 2025-05-19 14:23:24 (first 60% of time), flare windows NOT excluded
combined matrix has 347 tags = 346 process + 1 flare (prompt expected about 376: all tags -29, process tags only -30)
PCA fit rows = the full cleaned matrix (44640 rows); each process tag standardized over these rows (zero mean, unit variance); one PCA per unit on its own tags, top 16 components kept
APS_NVPS_LEU has 14 process tag(s): 14 PC(s) kept instead of 16
DAK has 5 process tag(s): 5 PC(s) kept instead of 16
ISOM_3 has 14 process tag(s): 14 PC(s) kept instead of 16
ISOM_4 has 3 process tag(s): 3 PC(s) kept instead of 16
SEU2 has 14 process tag(s): 14 PC(s) kept instead of 16
SEU3 has 14 process tag(s): 14 PC(s) kept instead of 16
PC scores standardized to unit variance (each divided by its std over the fit rows) before Stage 3
9054 cross-unit PC pairs are marginally dependent at alpha 0.01 (n = 4464); this is the most PC-PC edges PC can keep, since within-unit PC pairs are uncorrelated by construction

Fisher-Z in Stage 3 treats the 4464 subsampled rows as independent; with lag-10 autocorrelation median 0.93 the effective sample size is about 161, so p-values are too small and the graph can keep spurious edges
causal sufficiency: the 7.3% of process-tag variance outside the kept PCs is unobserved; a dependence carried only by dropped components is missed or appears as a spurious edge
flare tags enter PC as standardized in Stage 1 (reference mean / std); PC scores as standardized in Stage 2
PC runs on every 10th row of the node matrix (4464 rows): consecutive samples are strongly autocorrelated, and Fisher-Z uses the data only through the correlation matrix and n
PC depth cap max_k = 1: largest depth <= 3 whose CI-test upper bound (2.43e+06) fits the budget 3e+07
PC: causal-learn pc, Fisher-Z, stable = True, uc_rule = 0, uc_priority = 2, alphas [0.01, 0.05]; flare tags in tier 1 (no edge into tier 0, none within tier 1, so flare-flare edges are forbidden too)
